div.h1: Zipper composition — set-algebra combinators nest over base cursors

p.em: each combinator implements DictZipper and pulls from its operand cursors lazily

text.tspan: is_final = ALL operands final · descend = ALL can descend
children = ∩ of operands' labels · value = meet-merge

div.p: Color key · 🟦 blue = consumer driving the pull · 🟨 amber = set-algebra combinator (lazy, owns no storage) · 🟩 green = in-memory backend cursor (leaf DictZipper) · ⬜ grey = arrows / borders. Every combinator is itself a DictZipper, so operands may be backends or further combinators.

text.tspan: is_final = ANY final · descend = ANY can descend
is_final = left final AND NOT right final
